name: io.github.DrDroidLab/hindsight-sre
title: Hindsight SRE
description: Self-hosted, git-backed runbooks and reviewed incident learnings for coding agents.

environmentVariables.name: HINDSIGHT_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: URL of your team's Hindsight server. Defaults to the server saved by `hindsight login`.

environmentVariables.name: HINDSIGHT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Personal API key. Defaults to the private credential file written by `hindsight login`, which is preferred.

environmentVariables.name: HINDSIGHT_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Knowledge scope to read and write.
